XPENG Danmark | Ballerup

Vil du være med til at skabe en enestående kundeoplevelse hos et af de bilmærker i Danmark, der udvikler sig allerhurtigst?

XPENG vokser i Danmark, og vi søger en Finanssupervisor – Europa til vores team.

Ansvarsområder

• 
Lager- og varebeholdningsstyring-Sikre overensstemmelse mellem fysisk lager og regnskab, gennemføre lageroptællinger, afstemme finansielle og operationelle data samt koordinere og standardisere processer for varebeholdning i udlandet.

• 
Regnskab og rapportering-Kontrollere nøjagtigheden af virksomhedens regnskaber og sikre datakvalitet og integritet på tværs af alle konti.

• 
Revision og audit-koordinering-Koordinere og lede eksterne revisioner, håndtere forespørgsler, bekræftelser (confirmations) og stikprøveudtag (sample requests), gennemgå revisionsrapporter og sikre rettidig færdiggørelse og udstedelse.

• 
Lokale finansielle opgaver-Godkende overbetalinger, depositummer og andre refusioner i henhold til gældende politikker; overvåge forfaldne tilgodehavender, samarbejde med forretningen om at afklare afvigelser og accelerere inddrivelse; godkende stamdata for leverandører; gennemgå hastebetalingsanmodninger i forbindelse med kinesiske helligdage samt håndtere lokale bankrelaterede forhold og øvrige lokalt forankrede finansopgaver.

• 
Procesoptimering-Besvare spørgsmål vedrørende lokale finansprocesser (indbetalinger, udbetalinger m.m.) og gennemføre træning; indsamle pain points i brugen af forretningssystemer og samarbejde med hovedkontoret om løbende forbedring af finanssystemer for at styrke compliance og effektivitet.

Kvalifikationer

• 
Uddannelsesbaggrund-Bachelorgrad eller højere inden for finans, regnskab eller beslægtet område; minimum 2 års relevant erfaring inden for finans/regnskab.

• 
Faglige kompetencer-Indgående kendskab til kinesiske regnskabsstandarder (PRC GAAP) samt IFRS; stærke analytiske evner; rutineret bruger af ERP-systemer og standard kontorsoftware (fx Excel).

• 
Sprog-Flydende kinesisk og engelsk på professionelt arbejdssprog-niveau.

• 
Personlige egenskaber-Stærk forståelse for intern kontrol, robusthed under pres samt dokumenteret evne til at kommunikere og samarbejde på tværs af funktioner og interessenter.Finance Supervisor-Europe

XPENG Denmark | Ballerup

Would you like to help create an exceptional customer experience at one of the fastest-growing automotive brands in Denmark?

XPENG is growing in Denmark, and we are looking for a Finance Supervisor – Europe to join our team.   

Responsibilities

• 
Inventory Management – Ensure physical inventory accuracy, conduct stocktakes, reconcile financial and operational data, and streamline overseas inventory processes.

• 
Financial Reporting – Verify the correctness of financial books and maintain data integrity across all accounts.

• 
Audit Coordination – Lead external audits, handle inquiries, confirmations, and sample requests; review audit reports and ensure on-time delivery.

• 
Local Operations – Approve overpayments, deposits, and other refunds per policy; monitor overdue receivables, collaborate with business teams to resolve issues and accelerate collections; approve supplier master data; manage urgent payment reviews during domestic holidays and handle local banking matters.

• 
Process Optimization – Address local finance process questions (collections, payments, etc.), deliver training; gather system pain points and work with headquarters to continuously enhance financial systems for better compliance and efficiency.

Requirements

• 
Background – Bachelor’s degree or above in Finance or a related field; 2+ years of finance experience.

• 
Skills – Solid knowledge of PRC GAAP and IFRS; strong data analysis capabilities; proficient in ERP and office software.

• 
Language – Excellent command of both Chinese and English as working languages.

• 
Attributes – Strong internal control mindset, resilience under pressure, and proven cross-functional communication and collaboration skills.

Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challenge and the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricated tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department: The TE systems are part of the scope of the Marine team as temporary measures to facilitate the transport and immersion of the elements.

To float, move and immerse the Tunnel Elements, temporary installations are required. A team of mechanics, riggers and electricians installs and tests these systems. The Commissioning Engineer analyzes technical input to optimize performance and plan ahead, working closely with technical staff and operations.

Main tasks and responsibilities: The Site Engineer Automation ensures operational readiness of the temporary systems in the tunnel elements and continuously improves them based on operational feedback to optimize installation efficiency.

• 
Creates and follows a testing protocol for all installations.

• 
Leads the commissioning of the standard and special tunnel elements.

• 
Adapts system changes according to new insights.

• 
Provides correct reports and documentation to the site engineers.

• 
Is responsible for adjusting control systems, and coordinates changes.

Qualifications:

• 
Is fascinated by technology and wants to understand how things work.

• 
Is an analytical thinker and a fast learner, able to comprehend, design and improve systems.

• 
Has strong communication skills, necessary for project development with internal clients and contractors.

• 
Is a problem solver

• 
Speaks English.

Conditions: FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. FLC staff are expected to set their own targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions—irrespective of their position in the company. FLC offers attractive employment conditions on a Danish contract according to the Danish Salaried Employees Act (Funktionærloven). Pension, health insurance, and lunch arrangements will be available.

Workplace: Rødbyhavn, Denmark

Application: We look forward to receiving your application (in English) as soon as possible. Applications received will be processed on an ongoing basis, and we will complete the recruitment once we have found the right profile.

Contact:

For questions related to the position, please contact tri@flc-jv.com, lge@flc-jv.com

Do you want to contribute to protecting energy systems of the future and secure OT infrastructure in Renewable Energy? Then apply to become part of an international and market-leading asset management consultancy within the renewable energy industry. PEAK Wind is looking for a Cyber Security Consultant, who wants to take their cyber security career to the next level and is looking to work on a diverse and exciting portfolio within wind power and other renewable Energy sources.

Trusted Advisors for Developers and Investors for some of the Largest Renewable Assets
At PEAK Wind, we specialise in operations, asset management, and project management of Renewable Energy assets and take pride in providing best-in-class commercial, financial, and operational advisory and support to our clients. We work with some of the world’s largest infrastructure investments and are proud to count market-leading utilities, investment funds, and independent power producers among our clients.

Job Content, Responsibilities, and Possibilities:
Based in one of our offices in Denmark (Aarhus and Copenhagen), or Germany (Hamburg) you will be working in a team supporting customer projects and programs within the field of IT/OT and cyber security. We are a dedicated team of mixed seniorities and nationalities with a collaborative working environment. SCADA and Cyber Security is a crucial area for our clients, who we support on both greenfield and brownfield projects. The team works across disciplines, ensuring seamless integration, operation, and cyber security of OT, ICS, and SCADA systems.

Your responsibilities include:

- Leading risk assessments of IT/OT environments for clients across large-scale renewable assets, and providing risk mitigation strategies and recommendations.
- Developing IT/OT operating models, guidelines, and procedures for renewable assets.
- Developing and communicating IT/OT infrastructure designs to our customers.
- Implementing cyber security solutions for IT and OT environments on large-scale renewable assets, and reporting to project management, customers directly, and/or other senior engineering functions.
- Adapt to legislation and regulatory requirements for the IT/OT environment. Advise on the utilisation of best practices, policies, and standards, such as IEC62443, and ISO27000.
- Build strong relationships with stakeholders, in PEAK Wind and among our customers.

What you Bring and your Qualities
We expect that you have a minimum of 2-4 years of experience from a similar position, and previous experience with cyber security functions, such as Risk Management, Vulnerability Assessments, and Security Assessments. Furthermore, experience within security systems including firewalls and security engineering is required. Recognized security certification is desirable and experience with implementation of national standards such as NERC/CIP or NIS2 would be considered an advantage. The ideal candidate would have experience with renewable energy projects and/or implementation of Cyber Security Management Systems in other industries.

As a person, you are a team player, and you thrive working in an international and diverse team with mixed cultures and seniorities. You are detail-oriented and possess strong problem-solving skills in IT/OT systems. As PEAK Wind is a global company, you must also have strong English communication skills, both oral and written. Finally, we are looking for a candidate with excellent stakeholder management skills.

Experience the Highest Degree of Involvement
PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity and our values of Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity are materialized through our team members every day. Here you will be able to utilize your financial skills while developing a strong understanding of renewable energy assets. We offer an opportunity to get on board and experience the highest degree of involvement and responsibility in PEAK Wind’s global renewable energy team. Together with the rest of the team, you will play an instrumental part in the continued success of PEAK Wind. Above that, you will participate in an entrepreneurial environment, with a focus on cooperation and a desire to change the status quo. The position will also offer global exposure as our clients work globally.

Interested and want to know more?
If you have any questions or want to know more about the position, please contact People & Development via recruitment@peak-wind.com (recruitment@peak-wind.com) . We look forward to receiving your applications & CVs as soon as possible. Please apply through ‘Apply’ at the bottom of the page. Applications will be assessed on an ongoing basis.

PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

Do you want to contribute to a secure, reliable construction and operation of renewbale assets for a international and market-leading asset management consultancy within the renewable energy industry? PEAK Wind is looking for a Senior SCADA Consultant who can be an integrated part of our SCADA and Cyber Security team, ensuring best-in-class deliverables for our clients, and building a bridge between technical, commercial, and operational OT and SCADA assets.

We take pride in providing best-in-class commercial, financial, and operational advisory and support to our clients. Solution-driven Senior SCADA Consultant with Technical Network Know-how
Based in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Hamburg, or Zaragoza you will be supporting clients in all aspects of the project lifecycle, from early development to operation.

We are a dedicated team of mixed seniorities and nationalities with a collaborative way of working. SCADA and Cyber Security is a key area for our clients and receives increased attention on both greenfield and brownfield projects. Your responsibilities include:

- Drafting and reviewing requirements suppliers and service providers of OT systems, SCADA, and Cyber Security for renewable assets, mainly within onshore and offshore wind
- Negotiating SCADA and Cyber Security requirements in various supply and service contracts on behalf of our clients
- Designing basic network archtiecture and identifying functional requirements from network designes
- Supporting operational teams on OT, SCADA, and Cyber Security investigations and improvements
- Identifying and integrating technical upgrades, new systems, and functionalities
- Managing sub-suppliers for performance management, defining maintenance, and optimizing the reliability

Experienced SCADA Consultant with a holistic mindset:
We are looking for a candidate with knowledge within OT/SCADA systems and Cyber Security. You have broad experience working with SCADA, critical OT or IT systems, across the array of different systems used in production environments. Furthermore, you are familiar and used to working with security standards such as ISO270xx, IEC62443, NERC-CIP, or similar. Knowledge of industrial computer networks is an advantage but not a requirement.

Irrespective of your background, you are solution-oriented and like to find smarter and more efficient ways to solve problems. You are motivated by solving problems and finding solutions that work in the real world and not just on paper. Preferably you have experience in project management or experience from a Supervisor position, which has given you commercial awareness and the ability to work independently. Experience in the wind turbine industry will also be considered an advantage.

The ideal candidate is self-driven, proactive, and has a solution-oriented attitude. You are a good communicator with a proven ability to build sound business relationships and represent them in project meetings and presentations. As PEAK Wind is an international company, you need to have good English communication skills.
